name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 7 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-05-04, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
